evidence.decision: Separates stable destinations from commands and preserves independent section state, including empty or unavailable content.
evidence.artifact: Requires destination/state implementation or navigation contract with empty-state handling, retained context and an attention/badge policy.
evidence.transformation: Finance example keeps empty Transactions visible, moves payment creation out of Add-as-tab and restores prior account detail on return.
evidence.verification: Checks repeated section switching, modal return, empty content, localization and adaptation, failing action tabs or lost section context.
evidence.applicability: Preserves iPad five-or-fewer default customization guidance, TV Menu focus return, visionOS symbol-plus-label expansion and distinct watch page views.
evidence.handoffs: Loads toolbars for actions, sidebars for hierarchy and tab-views when the task concerns panes/pages rather than top-level destinations.
evidence.distinctiveness: Destination identity and retained navigation state govern the artifact, with explicit rejection of hidden empty tabs and command-as-destination behavior.
